Name: (AT)(CP) Visual Set for Kamichama Karin (Scarecrow and Furniture)
Author: Luozhu0901
Description:
This mod adds a scarecrow reskin featuring two characters from [i][b]Kamichama Karin[/b][/i]:
[b]Karin Hanazono[/b] and [b]Kazune Kujyou[/b], each with two outfits — their school uniforms and their transformed battle forms.
Due to canvas size limitations, the sprites had to be slightly scaled down, so they appear a bit smaller than the player character in-game. (Unfortunately, I haven’t figured out a way to make the scarecrow occupy more tiles visually. If you happen to know how, I’d love to hear from you!)
Requirements:
Besides [b]SMAPI[/b], you must install the [b]Alternative Textures[/b] mod. Once everything is installed, go to Robin’s shop to buy the paint bucket, then left-click on a scarecrow to change its appearance.
⸻
该模组为动画《小女神花铃》中的角色制作了稻草人美化，包含了两位角色：花园花铃和九条和音，每人各有两套服装——校服与神化后的战斗服。
由于像素画布的限制，图像在绘制时略作缩小，因此在游戏中显示会比主角略小一些。（目前还没有找到可以让稻草人图像在游戏中占据更多格子的办法，如果你知道怎么做，非常欢迎告诉我！）
前置需求：
除了[b]SMAPI[/b]外，还需要安装[b]Alternative Textures[/b]模组。安装成功后，前往罗宾家购买油漆桶，然后鼠标左键点击稻草人即可更换外观。




This is a second version of the mod with updated content.
This file contains two mods:
• An Alternative Textures (AT) mod: Adds new scarecrow appearances inspired by [b][i]Kamichama Karin[/i][/b]. After installing, get the paint bucket from Robin’s shop and right-click any scarecrow to switch appearances.
• A Content Patcher (CP) mod: Adds decorative furniture versions of the characters using the same artwork. These can be purchased from the Furniture Catalogue at Robin’s shop and placed freely on your farm. The normal forms are sized to match the farmer, but the transformed (goddess) versions are wider and take up two tiles. If you want to place both characters side-by-side without gaps, you’ll need a [b][i]Furniture Placement Tweaks[/i][/b] mod (14092).
⸻
二编
本文件包含两个模组：
• 一个 AT 模组：为稻草人添加了《小女神花铃》主题的外观。安装后，前往罗宾家购买油漆桶，右键点击稻草人即可切换外观。
• 一个 CP 模组：添加了同角色像素风格的小人摆件，可在罗宾家的家具目录中购买后摆放在农场上。普通服装与主角尺寸相匹配，而“神化后的战斗服装”宽度为两个格子。若想让两位角色贴紧站在一起，建议搭配使用“家具可重叠”类模组。(本人用的：[i][b]Furniture Placement Tweaks[/b][/i] mod (14092))
